requirements_summary.summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map or Telegram bot. Reports undergo a lifecycle from submission and approval by a Public Relations Officer to assignment, execution (by internal staff or external maintainers), and resolution. The system supports anonymity, two-way communication between citizens and operators, real-time notifications (email/push), and detailed public/private statistics.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: See similar story for citizen
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to create a new report through a Telegram bot
So that I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area.
constraints:
Allows the citizen to open a new report by selecting a location on the Turin map, entering a title, description, choosing a category, and attaching up to three photos. The bot also asks if the report should be anonymous.

Example command:

/newreport → Starts the guided process to create a new issue report with location, title, description, category, photos, and anonymity preference.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to check my report status through a Telegram bot 
So that I can quickly get updates.
constraints:
Check the status of their own reports, receiving an updated list with any changes.
Example commands:

/myreports → Lists all your submitted reports with their current status.

/reportstatus 12345 → Shows details and current status of report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly get updates

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to access quick assistance and help commands from the Telegram bot 
So that I can understand how to use the system and find useful contacts.
constraints:
Example commands:

/help → Lists available commands and how to use them.

/contact → Provides contact info for the Municipality support team.

/faq → Shows frequently asked questions
expected_behaviors: I can understand how to use the system and find useful contacts

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to follow reports done by other citizens 
So that I can be updated
constraints: Only not closed reports can be followed. Notifications follow the  the same rules as for owned reports.
expected_behaviors: I can be updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive real-time push notifications via the Telegram bot 
So that I know instantly when my report status changes.
constraints:
Example commands:

/subscribe → Enable real-time notifications for all your reports.

/unsubscribe → Disable notifications.

/subscribe report 12345 → Subscribe only to updates for report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I know instantly when my report status changes

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen /unregistered user
I want to see public statistics about reports 
So that I understand trends in city issues.
constraints: Public statistics  (visible on the site) include the number of reports by category and trends by day, week, or month.
expected_behaviors: I understand trends in city issues

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator 
I want to see detailed private statistics 
So that I can monitor usage and performance of the system.
constraints:
Private statistics (for administrators only), in addition to public ones, also include charts and tables about:  
  - number of reports by status  
  - number of reports by type  
  - number of reports by type and status  
  - number of reports by reporter  
  - number of reports by reporter and type  
  - number of reports by reporter, type and status  
  - number of reports by the top 1% of reporters, by type  
  - number of reports by the top 5% of reporters, by type
expected_behaviors: I can monitor usage and performance of the system

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Accepted reports automatically move to 'Assigned' state and are sent to the competent technical office based on category.
Once intervention is scheduled, status changes to 'In Progress'.
When resolved, technical office updates status to 'Resolved' and closes the report.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category (without initial review) is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Case 1 (External Maintainer Access): External maintainers can move reports from 'Assigned' to 'In Progress' and resolve them. Internal/External comments are exchanged but not visible to citizens.
Case 2 (No External Maintainer Access): External company updates technical office out of Participium; technical office staff moves report to 'Resolved'.
Email is a mandatory field for registration and can be used for login.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
Public Relation Officer can assign a report either to a specific technical office or directly to a staff member of that office.
Only authenticated users (citizens) could view reports initially; from Sprint 4, visitors (unregistered users) can also view reports.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public Turin map of reports for citizens.
Specific technical offices must be set up and mapped to report categories in project documentation.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Notifications/messages can be sent in real-time or when the page is refreshed based on user preference.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator; each maintainer should have their own individual account.
Assignment logic for external maintainers is left to the teams, similar to municipality technical offices.
edge_cases: User attempts to submit a report without registering: System blocks submission and prompts for registration.
Confirmation code expires (30 minutes): User cannot confirm account; must request new code or wait.
Citizen tries to modify/delete an existing report: System denies action with error message.
Report submitted with 0 photos: Form validation fails, user must attach at least 1 photo.
Report submitted with 4 photos: Form validation fails, user must reduce to max 3.
User zooms out on map significantly: Reports group into cumulative view showing total count.
User zooms in on map: Reports separate, showing title and reporter name (or 'anonymous').
Citizen tries to follow a closed (Resolved/Rejected) report: System prevents following or shows disabled state.
External maintainer attempts to comment on a report without access: Not applicable as they have no access in Case 2.

Telegram bot command '/newreport' sent by unregistered user: Bot may prompt for registration or allow guest submission depending on implementation (description implies guided process, FAQ says unregistered can view but description says 'citizens can submit reports only if registered'). Assumption: Registration required for Telegram report creation too.
Admin configures automatic assignment: Subsequent reports of that category skip the Public Relations Officer review step.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the initial review body before assignment.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).

Telegram bot integration requires the user to have a Telegram username configured in their profile for push notifications, though report creation might be possible without it (FAQ implies username needed for push, description says 'any citizen who has provided their Telegram username can communicate with a Telegram bot').
The 'top 1% of reporters' statistic calculates based on the number of reports submitted by each reporter.
Unregistered users viewing reports see only approved ones and cannot submit new reports (based on 'citizens can submit reports only if they have registered').
Internal comments exchanged between staff and external maintainers are stored in a separate thread or field not visible to the public view of the report.
The map layer is strictly OpenStreetMap standard layer as per description, though FAQ allows 'any other derivative map based on it'.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user views approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports. Verify that the response includes a list of reports where status is 'Approved' or equivalent (e.g., 'In Progress', 'Resolved'). Ensure the response format supports rendering on an interactive map (e.g., includes latitude, longitude, title). Do not require authentication headers.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality for unregistered users to view public data as per PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff member assigns reports to external maintainers.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to /officers/assign-report. Include headers for an authenticated 'technical_office_staff' role. In the body, provide a report ID and an external maintainer ID. Verify the response indicates successful assignment.
setup_needed: Ensure at least one report exists in 'Assigned' state.
Ensure an external maintainer account exists in the system.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present (e.g., check for new assignment logs or notifications).
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the specific workflow for technical staff assigning to external parties per PT24.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen searches for reports in a specific area by typing an address.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports. Include query parameters with 'address' set to a valid street name (e.g., 'Via Roma, 1'). Verify the response filters results to reports located near or within that address.
setup_needed: Ensure at least one report exists with a geolocation matching the query address.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the search/filtering capability for citizens per PT30 using an address parameter.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Unregistered user views approved reports on an interactive map.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports. Verify that the response includes reports with status 'Resolved' or 'Rejected'. Ensure these are visible if they meet the 'approved' criteria defined in domain rules (e.g., resolved issues). Check that no sensitive internal data is exposed.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests boundary conditions of 'approved' status visibility for unregistered users per PT28.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Technical office staff exchanges internal comments on a report without exposing them to citizens.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to create an internal message for a specific report. Authenticate as 'technical_office_staff_member'. The payload should include the report ID and a comment text. Verify that the message is created successfully.
setup_needed: Create a report via POST /reports with status 'Assigned'.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present. Note: Internal messages are stateful, but the cleanup strategy ensures no orphaned data remains.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the internal communication channel for technical office staff as per requirement PT26.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: External maintainer updates a report status, which triggers a state change dependent on previous assignment.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a PATCH request to update the status of a report from 'Pending Approval' to 'In Progress'. This should fail because the report must first be assigned. Verify that the system rejects this change with an appropriate error message.
setup_needed: Create a report via POST /reports with status 'Pending Approval'.
Ensure the report is NOT assigned to any technical office or maintainer.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Tests the dependency edge where a report must be assigned before its status can be updated by an external maintainer.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen registers with name and username to access the Participium system.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to register a new user. The payload should include 'name', 'username', and 'email'. Verify that the response indicates successful registration and provides a confirmation code or token.
setup_needed: Ensure no user with the same username exists.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the registration flow for citizens as per requirement PT01.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen confirms registration with a code to activate their account.
strategy_items.prompt: Execute a POST request to verify the OTP code for a user. First, register a user via POST /users and capture the confirmation code from the response. Then, send the code in the payload to verify the account.
setup_needed: Register a user via POST /users and capture the confirmation code from the response.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the account confirmation flow for citizens as per requirement PT27.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen selects a location on the city map to geolocate their report with latitude and longitude.
strategy_items.prompt: Submit a new report via POST /reports. The request body must include 'latitude' and 'longitude' fields derived from a map selection action (e.g., click event). Ensure the coordinates are valid numbers within acceptable ranges for the city.
setup_needed: Ensure user is authenticated as a citizen (session/token active).
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the core functionality of geolocation-based report submission.

strategy_items.requirement_summary: Citizen creates a new report through a Telegram bot so that they can quickly notify the public administration.
strategy_items.prompt: Initiate the Telegram authentication flow via POST /auth/telegram. The request body must include 'chat_id' and 'token'. Verify that the response provides a confirmation code or session token required to complete registration before submitting a report.
setup_needed: Ensure Telegram bot credentials are valid and active.
strategy_items.cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
strategy_items.rationale: Validates the entry point for Telegram-based report submission, ensuring the auth handshake works before data submission.
